-- @kind --
truth: hand-written; the JDK 8 SimpleFormatter that the station console uses prints Level.getLocalizedLevelName(), which upper-cases the Spanish bundle names (Configurar, Detallado, Muy Detallado, Más Detallado) in the es locale, but the bash and the port knew only GRAVE, ADVERTENCIA and INFORMACIÓN, so a CONFIGURAR, DETALLADO, MUY DETALLADO or MÁS DETALLADO header (UTF-8 or Latin-1) never closed the open WARNING/SEVERE block and its frames attached to the previous row; the port makes those exact names levels, the two-word ones read as one token across a single blank, while MUY, DETALLADOS, MÁS and MUY DETALLADOS stay no level
